decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's existing equipment portfolio that remained prominently marketed across 2023 and 2024, it fits the firm's accumulated know-how and can be improved through its in-house R&D and customer-process learning.

Although it may use some of the firm's digital fabrication capabilities, an orthopedic shoe last is relatively distant from its dental and hearing core, so absorptive capacity is weaker and the firm is more likely to reallocate resources if early learning and cross-selling potential are limited.

A post-curing unit is closely related to the firm's digital manufacturing workflow and materials expertise, so even with limited website prominence in 2024 the firm has the knowledge base to refine it and integrate it into its broader system offering.
